accepted_scope: Standard two-sided-orbit supercharacter theory of G=1+J for every finite-dimensional associative nilpotent F_q-algebra, all prime powers q.
accepted_claims: Unnormalized additive Fourier orbit sum equals canonical sum of irreducible degrees times irreducible characters.
Canonical pointwise-product coefficients are decomposition counts for one fixed target functional and are nonnegative integers.
Counts are constant on target two-sided orbits by simultaneous invertible linear action.
Conventional prefactor is one-sided orbit size divided by two-sided orbit size and is not generally one.
Argument covers nonprime finite fields, characteristic two and the trivial algebra.
scope_exclusions: Arbitrary theories on an algebra group
Unverified theorem numbers in unavailable Diaconis–Isaacs PDF
recommended_problem_classification: Proved algebra-group subcase; broader problem remains partial progress within this audit.

finite_stress_tests.role: sanity checks, not the general proof

canonical_normalization: sigma_O = sum_{chi in X_O} chi(1) chi = sum_{lambda in O} e_lambda
conventional_normalization: tau_O = (|lambda G|/|O|) sigma_O; tau_O is not generally sigma_O.
structure_coefficient: Number of pairs (lambda,mu) in O x P whose sum equals one fixed nu in target orbit R; not the total over all nu in R.

foundational_credit.title: Supercharacters and superclasses for algebra groups
